You are given a multiset of integers, A. Compute ∑limits_{B⊆ A} f(B) modulo 10^9+7.

Note that in this problem, we distinguish the elements by indices instead of values. That is, a multiset consisting of n elements always has 2^n distinct subsets regardless of whether some of its elements are equal.

The first line of input contains two integers n and k, where n is the number of elements in A (1≤ k≤ n≤ 600).

The second line of input contains n integers a_1,a_2,…,a_n, describing the elements in A (-10^9≤ a_i≤ 10^9).

Output ∑limits_{B⊆ A} f(B) modulo 10^9+7.
